readme_first_paragraph: A single JSON file, `plugins.json`, that can serve as a plugin registry for the [Reach](https://github.com/alexandrosnt/Reach) SSH client. It is for plugin authors who want a registry to publish to and for Reach users who want to point their marketplace at a registry of their own.
